**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

Section 4.2 (¶¶ p0025–p0029) requires the Company to pay HDI a "Termination Payment" equal to 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000 whenever we terminate. This is a customer-payable liquidated amount:

- **Fails preferred** (no LDs/penalties payable by Customer).
- **Fails fallback** (3 months' fees): our fees are 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, so the exit formula can exceed a full year of fees at any meaningful volume.
- **Aggravating factor:** it is triggered by ordinary 90-day non-renewal under Section 4.1, not only early exit — and it is one-way (Section 4.2(b) confirms HDI never pays us).

Redline validated (ok:true): delete Section 4.2 in full, with the fallback of a three-months'-fees cap offered in the comment.
